decisions.rationale: Mega Charizard Y is the intended Mega. Charizard + Venusaur immediately overwrite Pelipper rain, give Venusaur Chlorophyll speed, and force Solar Beam/Sleep Powder respect. Raichu supplies Fake Out and blocks opposing Electric attacks; Life Orb Garchomp closes versus Manectric, Houndoom, Pelipper, and Sneasler with its listed attacks.
decisions.notebook: Opponent registered core is Houndoom/Scarf Lightning Rod Manectric/Pelipper/Sneasler/Snorlax/Sinistcha. Respect Pelipper rain, Manectric Scarf Overheat, Sinistcha Rage Powder + Trick Room, and Houndoom Flash Fire when choosing Heat Wave. Primary mode remains Mega Charizard Y sun plus Chlorophyll Venusaur; Raichu and Garchomp form the preferred supporting endgame.

decisions.rationale: Lead Houndoom+Manectric: Houndoom's Flash Fire directly absorbs Charizard Y Heat Wave and threatens back with Fire Blast/Dark Pulse; Manectric's Scarf outspeeds Garchomp/Primarina and Lightning Rod pivots around Raichu. Back Pelipper+Sneasler: Pelipper's Wide Guard shuts down Heat Wave if Charizard Y stays in, and Drizzle recovers if Y faints; Sneasler's White Herb→Unburden sweep with Close Combat crushes Goodra-Hisui and Primarina late.
decisions.notebook: Opponent confirmed sun mode: CharizarditeY Drought, Venusaur Chlorophyll Focus Sash, Raichu Lum Berry Lightning Rod Fake Out (not Talonflame). Speed notes: Venusaur Chlorophyll in sun = 200-264, barely beats Manectric Scarf 258 at max; Charizard Y 132-167 beats Houndoom 161 at max. Plan: Houndoom Flash Fire pivot into Charizard Y Heat Wave for boost, Manectric Scarf Overheat on Venusaur/Primarina, Pelipper Wide Guard vs Heat Wave, Sneasler Unburden sweep after White Herb proc. Snorlax Curse sweep and Sinistcha Trick Room held in reserve for game 2/3 if sun mode is replaced.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolution gives sun and activates Chlorophyll, letting Venusaur move ahead of Scarf Manectric. Earth Power threatens the immediate Manectric KO, while Air Slash is Charizard’s strongest listed direct attack into Houndoom and avoids Flash Fire. This pressures both opposing attackers before they can focus Venusaur.
decisions.notebook: Opponent led Houndoom/Choice Scarf Lightning Rod Manectric into Charizard/Venusaur. Mega Charizard Y sun activates Venusaur Chlorophyll; Venusaur then exceeds Scarf Manectric’s listed maximum Speed. Preserve the Charizard Y + Venusaur mode unless rain or Trick Room positioning makes Garchomp/Raichu preferable.

decisions.rationale: Garchomp gains the safest entry into Scarf-locked Overheat, threatens both current foes with Rock Slide or Ground STAB, and preserves Raichu’s Fake Out/Lightning Rod utility for later. Raichu would be pressured by Houndoom and does not punish the board as immediately.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Manectric is Timid Choice Scarf Lightning Rod and revealed Overheat, Thunderbolt, Volt Switch, Snarl; it was locked into Overheat after using it. Houndoom has Charcoal Flash Fire with Nasty Plot, Dark Pulse, Fire Blast, Protect. Pelipper carries Damp Rock Drizzle with Hydro Pump, Hurricane, Wide Guard, Protect. Preserve Charizard sun mode when possible; pivot toward Garchomp/Raichu if rain or Trick Room is established.

decisions.rationale: Focus fire on Venusaur. Houndoom Fire Blast (85.6-154.8% with Charcoal) likely OHKOs or breaks Sash; Manectric Overheat (55.1-98.1%) cleans up. Even if Venusaur outspeeds Manectric in sun and Sleep Powders one mon, the other breaks Sash. Sets up Houndoom Flash Fire boost if Charizard-Y Heat Waves.

decisions.rationale: Split targeting gives the highest-accuracy immediate double KO line: Air Slash always KOs Houndoom from 40%, while Stomping Tantrum removes 3% Manectric. Houndoom is slower than Garchomp, and Manectric’s locked Overheat is resisted. If Houndoom Protects, we still reliably remove Manectric without risking Rock Slide accuracy.

Manectric at 3% is dead regardless and locked into Overheat (0.5x on both foes). Best use: chip Charizard-Y before fainting. Houndoom Protect scouts Charizard-Y/Garchomp moves, avoids Garchomp SE Rock Slide that could KO at 40% HP, and sets up a safe Nasty Plot next turn when sun is still up. Preserves Houndoom as the win condition.

Pelipper resists Fire and is immune to Ground (Stomping Tantrum), making it the safest switch-in. Wide Guard next turn blocks Heat Wave and Rock Slide. Sneasler is faster but takes massive damage from Air Slash (SE) and sun-boosted Heat Wave, and sun staying up keeps boosting Charizard's moves. Key lesson: Pelipper Drizzle is the hard answer to sun; bring it the moment Manectric falls to deny Charizard-Y sun-boosted spread damage.

decisions.rationale: Pivoting Raichu preserves Charizard from rain-boosted Hydro Pump and Lightning Rod can absorb it. Garchomp is faster than Houndoom and Stomping Tantrum is a guaranteed KO at its shown HP; this also ignores Pelipper’s likely Wide Guard. If Houndoom’s reduced-success Protect works, Raichu still denies Hydro Pump pressure.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Houndoom)
decisions.rationale: Wide Guard blocks the most likely opposing line (Garchomp Rock Slide + Charizard-Y Heat Wave double spread). Dark Pulse into Charizard-Y pressures the opponent's win condition. Houndoom at 40% cannot risk a 2x SE Ground hit, so Nasty Plot is too dangerous if Garchomp switches to Stomping Tantrum. Hydro Pump is too slow (Pelipper 101 Spe moves after both foes), so Rock Slide would KO Houndoom before the OHKO attempt resolves.
decisions.notebook: Sun mode confirmed game 1: CharizarditeY Drought, Venusaur Chlorophyll FocusSash Modest, Raichu LumBerry LightningRod FakeOut. Pelipper Drizzle is the hard answer to sun; bring it the moment Manectric falls to deny Charizard-Y sun-boosted spread damage. Wide Guard is the key tech to neutralize Garchomp Rock Slide + Charizard-Y Heat Wave double-spread lines. Houndoom Flash Fire pivot is valuable but fragile below 50%. Sneasler Unburden sweep with White Herb held in reserve for late-game cleanup. Snorlax Curse sweep and Sinistcha Trick Room held for game 2/3 if sun mode is replaced. Opponent bench: Raichu FakeOut support, Goodra-Hisui special wall, Primarina LiquidVoice. Speed tiers: Sneasler 172 > Garchomp 134-169 > Charizard-Y 132-167 > Houndoom 161 > Pelipper 101.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Thunderbolt is a guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper and bypasses Wide Guard. Protect denies both Pelipper’s rain-boosted Hydro Pump and Sneasler’s likely Close Combat into Garchomp, preserving the favorable two-on-one versus Sneasler. If Pelipper Protects, Garchomp remains safely positioned for the next turn.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Sneasler)
decisions.rationale: Sneasler Close Combat threatens Garchomp KO (likely OHKO at 80% with 120 BP STAB Fighting vs neutral Dragon/Ground). Pelipper Wide Guard blocks Garchomp RockSlide, protecting Pelipper from 2x SE spread. Even if Raichu Fakes Out Sneasler (priority +3 flinch), Wide Guard keeps Pelipper safe. Next turn Raichu cannot Fake Out again, so Sneasler gets a free Close Combat on Garchomp. Preserves Sneasler Protect for later Unburden sweep setup.
decisions.notebook: Sun mode confirmed game 1: CharizarditeY Drought, Venusaur Chlorophyll FocusSash Modest, Raichu LumBerry LightningRod FakeOut. Pelipper Drizzle is the hard answer to sun; Wide Guard is the key tech to neutralize Garchomp RockSlide + Charizard-Y Heat Wave double-spread lines. Sneasler Unburden sweep with White Herb held in reserve for late-game cleanup. Snorlax Curse sweep and Sinistcha Trick Room held for game 2/3 if sun mode is replaced. Opponent bench: Goodra-Hisui special wall, Primarina LiquidVoice. Speed tiers: Sneasler 172 > Garchomp 134-169 > Charizard-Y 132-167 > Pelipper 101. Raichu FakeOut is the main flinch threat to Sneasler; play around it with Protect or accept the flinch when Wide Guard covers the spread.

decisions.rationale: Nuzzle is guaranteed to move before Sneasler and cuts its Speed, ensuring Garchomp acts before it even at maximum opposing Speed. Stomping Tantrum is super effective and a guaranteed OHKO if it connects. This covers an immediate Close Combat line; Protect is the only meaningful denial and leaves Sneasler vulnerable next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Sneasler is Adamant White Herb Unburden with Close Combat, Acrobatics, Dire Claw, Protect. It can reach 172 raw Speed before paralysis but is slower than Raichu. Pelipper is Damp Rock Drizzle with Hydro Pump, Hurricane, Wide Guard, Protect.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler outspeeds Garchomp 172>134-169. Close Combat is SE 2x on Garchomp and OHKOs at 80% even through Life Orb bulk. Removes the biggest SE Ground threat and the Life Orb user. Fake Out already failed (Sneasler in since t3). White Herb cleans the -1 Atk/Def drop next turn so Sneasler stays a threat vs Charizard-Y and Raichu. Pelipper is fainted, only Pass available.

reflections.summary: Won by preserving Charizard through the lead exchange, then using Garchomp and Raichu’s single-target pressure to bypass Pelipper’s repeated Wide Guard. The Charizard/Venusaur lead was not ideal into Houndoom + Scarf Manectric: Venusaur was immediately traded, but the brought four still matched well once Garchomp removed Manectric and Raichu checked Pelipper/Sneasler.
reflections.adjustment: For game 2, consider leading Garchomp + Charizard or Raichu rather than committing Venusaur into the likely Houndoom/Manectric lead; keep Venusaur only if its sleep or Ground coverage is needed. Continue favoring targeted attacks over spread moves while Pelipper is available to Wide Guard.
reflections.notebook: Opponent showed Houndoom as Timid Charcoal Flash Fire with Nasty Plot, Dark Pulse, Fire Blast, Protect; it threatens Venusaur and discourages Fire targeting. Manectric is Timid Choice Scarf Lightning Rod with Thunderbolt, Volt Switch, Overheat, Snarl; its Scarf speed and Lightning Rod make Raichu/Charizard lead positioning important. Pelipper repeatedly used Wide Guard, so single-target pressure is reliable into its rain mode. Sneasler is Adamant White Herb Unburden with Close Combat, Acrobatics, Dire Claw, Protect; Raichu outspeeds it before paralysis and Nuzzle is an effective control option. Future plan: avoid exposing Venusaur early to the Houndoom/Manectric lead; bring Garchomp and Raichu as core answers to Manectric, Pelipper, and Sneasler.

reflections.summary: Team preview was the primary failure: bringing Houndoom and Manectric into a sun matchup where both are actively harmed by Drought and neither benefits from my own Pelipper rain. Manectric was OHKO'd by Venusaur Earth Power on turn 1, Houndoom was chipped by Air Slash and then OHKO'd by Garchomp Stomping Tantrum. Compounding this, I never Mega Evolved Houndoom (the only Mega on my squad) and misused Wide Guard on turns 3-4 against single-target Thunderbolt instead of saving it for Garchomp Rock
reflections.adjustment: Rebuild the four for game 2 around Pelipper + Sneasler as the core. Drop Manectric (redundant LightningRod, OHKO'd by Earth Power in sun) and replace Houndoom with Snorlax or Sinistcha so the squad actually benefits from rain. If Houndoom stays, commit to Mega Houndoom on turn 1 for the special-attack boost and Fire-type STAB under rain. reflections.notebook: Sun mode durable notes (game 1 confirmed): Charizard-Y Drought + Venusaur Chlorophyll FocusSash Modest is the core; Raichu LumBerry LightningRod runs FakeOut + Nuzzle (paralysis is the real threat, not just flinch); Garchomp LifeOrb Jolly carries Stomping Tantrum for coverage and RockSlide for spread. Opponent bench: Goodra-Hisui ShellArmor Leftovers special wall, Primarina LiquidVoice SitrusBerry. Critical corrections: Wide Guard ONLY blocks spread moves — do not waste it on single-target hits; Pelipper Wide Guard into self still takes single-target damage. Manectric is OHKO'd by Modest Venusaur Earth Power in sun — never bring Manectric into this matchup. Houndoom without Mega is too frail to survive Charizard-Y Air Slash chip + Garchomp Stomping Tantrum; if Houndoom is brought, Mega Evolve turn 1. Speed tiers confirmed: Sneasler 172 > Garchomp 134-169 > Charizard-Y 132-167 > Pelipper 101. Future plans: game 2 bring Pelipper + Sneasler + Snorlax (Curse body) + one of {Mega Houndoom, Sinistcha Trick Room}. Lead Pelipper+Sneasler, set rain turn 1, Sneasler Close Combat into Venusaur or Charizard-Y depending on opponent lead. Save Wide Guard for predicted Rock Slide / Heat Wave turns. Hold Sinistcha Trick Room as the answer if opponent pivots to a non-sun mode in game 3.
